column3: #2651 closed: the post-insert DSN write is now SetDynamicSecretConfigAdminDSN, a targeted UPDATE of admin_dsn_enc/admin_dsn_meta/updated_at that cannot write disabled=false back over a concurrent DeleteProject (#369); and LocalStorage.CreateDynamicSecretConfig re-reads the project FOR SHARE after its insert, in one transaction, rolling back if it is gone (deleteProjectCascade locks the project first). requireDynamicSecretAdminAuthority remains an actor check. Proven: TestCTAReview_CreateDynamicSecretConfig_vs_DeleteProject_CrossReplicaPostgres (fails with the full-row Save), _DeleteProjectAfterInsert_ (fails without the insert re-check).
